svg.title: Zener diode
svg.desc: Zener diode, IEEE 315-1975 §8.5.6.1 breakdown diode, unidirectional (voltage regulator), style 2. Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: start (anode) (29,8), end (cathode) (29,68).
